method.scope: Model-visible characters when identical large read-only evidence is requested after compaction.
method.arm_a: v0.13 behavior: replay state is cleared, then ordinary large-output compaction runs.
method.arm_b: Compaction-safe exact capsule dictionary plus a bounded replay reference.
method.accounting: B conservatively includes PreCompact dictionary characters and the post-compaction replay reference.
method.exclusion: Character exposure is not provider billing, cache behavior, latency, or the hidden compaction model cost.
